name: hud_drift_tray
description: The Drift tray in a duel on Undertow's own rules (design 1.4 and 5.7, contract-m7.md §3), against the caretaker (tests/ui/duel_stage.gd starts the real preset; my seat plays its plan through wave 1). It shows only in a duel, standing on the console's left wing over the minimap and clear of the crest's arch at 1280 x 720. Before window 2 the Drift is shut and no pack shows. When window 2 opens for both hollows it offers the simulation's three packs (SimMatch.drift_offer()), each with its name and icon (the creep's framed portrait with a bottle on it), its key 1 to 3 and tier I's price, 30. The caretaker, given the gold for it (tier I costs more than its fifth of what it holds in window 2 since the sends' pass), corked in the window: its bottle shows only its tier, the record holds no pack, and its cork is told by tier. A click on a pack corks it: the price is kept back at once (the gold greys), the bottle stands in my sockets with the pack I put in it, and once the turn runs the gold is spent and the packs grey (one cork a window). Another key is refused before it goes out ('No corks left this window'). Hovering a pack or the rival's bottle explains it. Outside a duel the tray hides.

steps.assert: not node('DriftTray').visible and not node('DuelBar').visible
steps.msg: no tray and no duel bar outside a duel

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene)
steps.msg: a duel on the real preset: me on the first hollow, a caretaker rival on the second

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').defend(scene)
steps.msg: my seat plays its plan

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').visible and node('DuelBar').visible and Game.is_duel() and scene.hollows_shown() == 2
steps.msg: the tray and the bar show in a duel

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').packs_shown() == [] and Game.duel_window() == 1 and node('DriftTray').find_child('Tier', true, false).text == 'FROM WAVE 2'
steps.msg: the Drift opens from window 2: no pack before

steps.assert: tray.position.x >= 8 and tray.end.y <= 720 - 142 and tray.end.y >= 720 - 160 and tray.end.x <= 400 and tray.position.y > 300
steps.msg: on the left wing's painted top, over the minimap, left of the crest's arch

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').gold_for(2, 400)
steps.msg: the caretaker rival's gold, so it corks in window 2: tier I costs 45 since the sends' pass, more than its fifth of what it holds there

steps.assert: Game.duel_window() == 2 and offer.size() == 3 and Game.drift_packs() == offer and packs.size() == 3
steps.msg: window 2 open for both: the simulation's three packs on offer

steps.assert: packs[0]['check'] == offer[0] and packs[1]['check'] == offer[1] and packs[2]['check'] == offer[2] and packs[0]['key'] == '1' and packs[2]['key'] == '3'
steps.msg: the offer in its order, on keys 1 to 3

steps.assert: packs[0]['price'] == 45 and packs[1]['price'] == 45 and packs[2]['state'] == 'ok' and node('DriftTray').find_child('Tier', true, false).text == 'TIER I' and node('DriftTray').find_child('Price', true, false).text == '45'
steps.msg: tier I's price, the same for every pack

steps.assert: packs[0]['name'] == Game.PACKS['hollow'][offer[0]]['name'] and packs[0]['icon'] == 'res://ui/icons/pack_hollow_%s.png' % offer[0] and Game.has_art(packs[0]['icon'])
steps.msg: each with its name and its painted icon

steps.assert: ['Gourd Rush', 'Scuttle', 'Thorn Herd', 'Moth Cloud'] == [Game.PACKS['hollow']['swarm']['name'], Game.PACKS['hollow']['swift']['name'], Game.PACKS['hollow']['armored']['name'], Game.PACKS['hollow']['winged']['name']]
steps.msg: Wickhollow's packs

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(2).size() == 1 and not Game.bottles_of(2)[0].has('pack') and Game.bottles_of(2)[0]['tier'] == 0 and Game.bottles_of(2)[0]['window'] == 2
steps.msg: the caretaker corked a tier I bottle in the window, and the record holds no pack

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').rivals_shown() == [{'tier': 'I', 'pack': '', 'candidates': Game.bottles_of(2)[0]['candidates']}] and Game.bottles_of(2)[0]['candidates'].size() == 3 and node('Rival1').get_node('Tier').text == 'I' and Game.team_notices.has('Your rival corked a tier I bottle')
steps.msg: the rival's bottle shows its tier and its candidates (M8), never its pack, and its cork is told by tier

steps.assert: tip[0] == '%s (2)' % Game.PACKS['hollow'][offer[1]]['name'] and tip[1].contains('walk your rival') and tip[1].contains('45 gold') and tip[1].contains('+4 gold a wave') and tip[1].contains('tier I bottle')
steps.msg: hovered, a pack says what it sends, its price, its stipend and what the rival sees

steps.assert: Game.send_premium_words() == "each with 25% more health than the wave's own" and tip[1].contains(' · %s, ' % Game.CHECKS[offer[1]]['name'] + Game.send_premium_words(offer[1]) + '. ')
steps.msg: and that its creeps come stronger than the wave's own, by its pack's premium in the rules

steps.assert: Game.send_premium_words(offer[1]) == "each with %d%% more health than the wave's own" % ((int(Game.pack_info(offer[1], 0)['hp_pm']) - 1000) / 10) and Game.send_premium_words('winged') == Game.send_premium_words()
steps.msg: each pack says its own premium (the packs' matrix: the Gourd Rush and the Scuttle have their own, the Thorn Herd and the Moth Cloud the duel's)

steps.assert: Game.pending_gold == 45 and node('Gold').text == str(gold - 45) and node('DriftTray').mine_shown().size() == 1 and node('DriftTray').mine_shown()[0]['pack'] == offer[0]
steps.msg: a click corks it: the price kept back at once, the bottle with my pack in my socket

steps.assert: Game.gold == gold - 45 and Game.bottles_of(1).size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == offer[0] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['id'] > 0 and not Game.bottles_of(1)[0].has('pack')
steps.msg: the turn ran: the gold spent and the bottle the simulation keeps, its pack known only here

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').mine_shown()[0]['text'] == 'wave 2' and node('DriftTray').packs_shown()[1]['state'] == 'idle'
steps.msg: it waits for wave 2, which it names; one cork a window, the packs grey

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'No corks left this window' and Game.bottles_of(1).size() == 1
steps.msg: another is refused before it goes out

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[0] == "Your rival's bottle" and node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[1].begins_with('Tier I, corked for wave 2')
steps.msg: hovered, it says its tier, its wave and its candidates, never which

steps.assert: not node('DriftTray').visible and not node('DuelBar').visible
steps.msg: back in High Water the tray hides
